steps.name: font-evidence

steps.name: shader-pixels
steps.eval: (async()=>{const M=await import('/libs/paper-shaders/shader-mount.js?v=3');const F=await import('/libs/paper-shaders/shaders/mesh-gradient.js?v=3');const S=await import('/libs/paper-shaders/shader-sizing.js?v=3');const C=await import('/libs/paper-shaders/get-shader-color-from-string.js?v=3');const SIZING={u_fit:S.ShaderFitOptions[S.defaultObjectSizing.fit],u_scale:S.defaultObjectSizing.scale,u_rotation:S.defaultObjectSizing.rotation,u_offsetX:S.defaultObjectSizing.offsetX,u_offsetY:S.defaultObjectSizing.offsetY,u_originX:S.defaultObjectSizing.originX,u_originY:S.defaultObjectSizing.originY,u_worldWidth:S.defaultObjectSizing.worldWidth,u_worldHeight:S.defaultObjectSizing.worldHeight,u_imageAspectRatio:1};const host=document.createElement('div');host.style.cssText='position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:320px;height:180px;opacity:0.01;pointer-events:none';document.body.appendChild(host);const colors=['#eef1fd','#8ea5f7','#3e63dd','#9b6fd6','#f6c67a'].map(C.getShaderColorFromString);const m=new M.ShaderMount(host,F.meshGradientFragmentShader,Object.assign({u_colors:colors,u_colorsCount:5,u_distortion:0.85,u_swirl:0.26,u_grainMixer:0.14,u_grainOverlay:0.05},SIZING),{preserveDrawingBuffer:true},0.8,0,1,320*180);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1200));const gl=m.gl,w=m.canvasElement.width,h=m.canvasElement.height;const px=new Uint8Array(w*h*4);gl.readPixels(0,0,w,h,gl.RGBA,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,px);const sum=[0,0,0],min=[255,255,255],max=[0,0,0];let n=0,sq=0;for(let i=0;i<px.length;i+=4*7){const r=px[i],g=px[i+1],b=px[i+2];sum[0]+=r;sum[1]+=g;sum[2]+=b;for(let k=0;k<3;k++){const v=px[i+k];if(v<min[k])min[k]=v;if(v>max[k])max[k]=v;}const lum=0.2126*r+0.7152*g+0.0722*b;sq+=lum*lum;n++;}const mean=sum.map(s=>Math.round(s/n));const meanLum=0.2126*mean[0]+0.7152*mean[1]+0.0722*mean[2];const out={glSize:[w,h],mean,min,max,meanLum:Math.round(meanLum),sdLum:Math.round(Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,sq/n-meanLum*meanLum))),inViewport:m.isInViewport,currentSpeed:m.currentSpeed,alphaFirst:px[3]};m.dispose();host.remove();return JSON.stringify(out);})()
